title: Value of a client_secret field in a Box token request
summary: A synthetic value of client_secret beside client_id in a raw form-encoded request to the token endpoint, a curl -d argument and a Python form dictionary.
rationale: The field is the carrier: Box documents the client secret as the client_secret field of the application/x-www-form-urlencoded body of a token request, and marks it required beside client_id on the refresh request. Box states no prefix, alphabet or length for the secret, so the value is flagged because of the field it sits in, not because of its shape. The extent is the value only: the field name, the equals sign or colon, the ampersand and the quotes are outside it, and the client_id beside it identifies the application.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Flagged under project policy: a value in the client_secret field of a token request is treated as a credential whatever its shape. Box documents the client_secret request field at the token endpoint (carrier existence only); the value admission, extent and a generic attribution are the project's decisions. No subtype is inferred, and no prefix, width or alphabet is claimed.

sources.supports: The client secret of the application requesting an access token.
The client secret of the application requesting to refresh the token.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
